name: Linda C. Butler
biography: is a computer science student currently interning at the University of Rhode Island's Digital Forensics and Cyber Security Program. Past activities include an internship in the NASA Engineering department at Kennedy Space Center, a backpacking trip through New Zealand, and performing at a renaissance faire. She's an OWASP member and past DEFCON Attendee, and finds the interaction between security, privacy, and society an endlessly fascinating area of study.
